name: Glassmorphism
fit: Frosted blur panels over rich bg; chrome/modals, not dense tables.
surfaces: backdrop-blur cards with light borders over gradients or imagery.
type: Sans UI; avoid thin weights on glass.
color: Desaturated fills at low opacity; vivid backdrop optional.
motion: Fade and soft slide for overlays.
bestFor: Modals, nav over heroes, light dashboards.
avoid: Every card frosted; analytics tables on blur.
adapt: Limit glass to elevated surfaces; solidify reading panes.
